$comment: Machine-readable contract between this lab and the clusterdrill application release it installs. See bootstrap/control-plane.sh (the code that actually reads app.version/app.image_digest) and bootstrap/README.md. Update this file, and the pinned versions in bootstrap/control-plane.sh and bootstrap/node-common.sh, together in the same commit whenever any of them change - they must never drift apart.

app.install_method: pip/pipx wheel install from a GitHub Release asset (release_repository, tag v<version>) - not PyPI, which has no clusterdrill package. See bootstrap/control-plane.sh.
app.required_privileges: A single namespaced ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding pair scoped to the resource kinds the practice-bank question set actually needs (core, apps, batch, autoscaling, networking.k8s.io, policy, rbac.authorization.k8s.io, storage.k8s.io, apiextensions.k8s.io, plus explicitly-named questions/helm-crds CRD groups) - no cluster-admin binding, no wildcard apiGroup. See practice-bank/clusterdrill/manifests/local-appliance.yaml's ClusterRole and practice-bank/README.md's Security limits section.

kubernetes.bootstrap_pinned_patch: kubelet/kubeadm/kubectl resolve to whatever pkgs.k8s.io's stable:/v1.33 apt channel serves at install time - the minor is pinned (bootstrap/node-common.sh's KUBERNETES_MINOR), the exact patch is not
kubernetes.supported_range: Any Kubernetes minor where apps/v1, rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1, and core v1 are the stable API versions (true since 1.19) - the manifest uses only those, no alpha/beta APIs. Not independently tested across a version matrix beyond the pinned bootstrap minor above.
